changelog:
Initial release of Build Landing Page from Description:

- Generates complete, responsive landing pages—including copy, layout, hero image—from a simple text description.
- Designed for rapid product launches by startups, solopreneurs, and agencies.
- Clarifies audience and needs, drafts optimized pages, and supports further enrichment and refinement.
- Integrates chat, UI, and image generation APIs for seamless creation.
- Includes suggested prompt and SEO keywords for easy discoverability.
summary: Generates a complete landing page with copy, layout, hero image, and responsive design from a text description. Use when launching a product quickly.
